group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-03: 'Zhang S[au] AND WWOX AND ovarian' 1 (this paper); the surname is too common for a meaningful author total.
group_assessment.weighting: A gynaecology department group, unfunded by its own declaration, with no prior WWOX record; blots are representative without densitometry, and WWOX claims rest on overexpression and one siRNA.

field_density.note: Ten PubMed records join WWOX and autophagy; the direction is disputed among them (FT-074).

multihop.enumeration_method: 44 numbered references on the reading-order text; Europe PMC and Crossref hold no reference list for this DOI. Gene-direct references identified by title and resolved by PubMed title search; two (Gao 2016 osteosarcoma miR-214-3p; Baryla 2015 'Alteration of WWOX in human cancer') returned no PubMed hit and one (Lo 2015 review) returned several, so those three are named here and not listed.

multihop.note: Tsai 2013 (PMID 24008736) is the one reference that carries the autophagy direction; its corpus readings are partial only because its deposited supplement belongs to another article (FT-074).

corpus_crossquery.query: What sign does the corpus record for WWOX on autophagy, and on what measurement?
corpus_crossquery.finding: FT-074 and the 2026-09-21 audit: suppressive on steady-state autophagy-protein abundance in 24008736, flux never clamped on a WWOX arm, mTOR route asserted. This paper repeats that pattern: the only lysosomal clamp is on the drug arm.

retraction_check.result: No retraction, expression of concern or correction in the PubMed record. Article types: Journal Article.

source_artifacts.note: Publisher bronze-OA PDF, 11 pages, located through OpenAlex; digest identical to the selector's copy. Figures 1-4 inspected as rendered pages (pdftoppm, 110 dpi).
DERIVED text layer (pdftotext -layout -nopgbrk). Two-column layout; the source uses U+2011 non-breaking hyphens throughout ('p‑mTOR'), which the locators carry exactly.
Supplementary Figure S1 (one page: viability counts of A2780, SKOV3, A2780/T over 0-48 h PTX). No WWOX content. Rendered and inspected.
